bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
COMPOSE="$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
test -f "$COMPOSE" || exit 31
PREV_ID=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')
case "$PREV_ID" in sha256:7246be5bc24b*) ;; *) echo LIVE_IMAGE_DRIFT_ABORT; exit 32;; esac
NEW_ID=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:no-link-no-guide-096b1ea --format '{{.Id}}')
test "$NEW_ID" != "$PREV_ID" || exit 33
OLD_CID=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$OLD_CID" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 || exit 34
test "$(docker inspect "$OLD_CID" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$PREV_ID" || exit 35
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:backup-before-no-link-no-guide-20261113
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:no-link-no-guide-096b1ea gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$COMPOSE" up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/tmp/gaybbs-no-link-deploy.log 2>&1; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:backup-before-no-link-no-guide-20261113 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p deploy -f "$COMPOSE" up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 exit 36
fi
OK=0
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do
 sleep 2
 CID=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
 if test -n "$CID" && test "$(docker inspect "$CID" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$NEW_ID" && docker logs --since=60s "$CID" 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY; then OK=1; break; fi
done
if test "$OK" -ne 1; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:backup-before-no-link-no-guide-20261113 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p deploy -f "$COMPOSE" up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 echo GAYBBS_DEPLOY_ROLLED_BACK
 exit 37
fi
SERVICE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)
test "$SERVICE" = active || exit 38
gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "GAYBBS_NO_LINK_NO_GUIDE_DEPLOY_20261113 deployed=true from_image=${PREV_ID:0:19} to_image=${NEW_ID:0:19} bot_ready=true resident_userbot=$SERVICE rollback_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:backup-before-no-link-no-guide-20261113 new_topic_posts=0" >/dev/null || exit 39
echo GAYBBS_NO_LINK_NO_GUIDE_DEPLOY_PASS
